row.title: A cancelled run is not a verdict: the CI probe skips cancelled and skipped runs (PROBE-CONCLUSIVE-1)
row.body: ciwatch --probe read the newest completed run; pending executor jobs cancelled by a newer one made it 'cancelled', so Q-CIFAIL-ultrastable-executor was marked vacuous (probe passed) while every executor run that worked an item failed. latest() now passes over cancelled, skipped and stale runs.
